method: Measured results from published sources, not our own benchmarks. decode_tok_s is token generation speed; prefill_tok_s is prompt processing; ttft_s is time to first token. Context matters: a result at 4K is not a result at 128K. A missing prefill cell means the source did not report it, not that it is zero.

rows.note: Third-party measurement on the closest M5-class box, not a Bosgame. 4K/16K/32K prompt reads were 755/821/792 tok/s; 4K TTFT 0.60 s.
69% of the prompt came from the conversation cache; 4.5 s to first token per turn.
